description: (Originally posted on another site Nov 5, 2025)Legislative District 35 Republican Representative Dan Griffey tends to keep a lower profile than his seat-mate, Travis Couture. He co-sponsors fewer bills that fail in committee, but he frequently votes ‘NAY’ on legislation that ultimately becomes law. Griffey co-sponsored two bills that, in my opinion, show a troubling disregard for democratic norms.HB 1802 (2025) “Prohibiting obstructing a law enforcement officer or other first responder.”Dan Grif
paid_for_by: Sponsored by Griffey and Couture, but Griffey initially voted against it before switching his vote to Yay
title: Dan Griffey’s Disturbing Legislative Voting Record
